description:
1. The agent must run `bash /workspace/openclaw/scripts/check_update.sh` (resolving `{baseDir}` to `/workspace/openclaw`) to discover current version 2024.3.1 and available version 2024.6.15.
2. Because the user explicitly requested the BETA channel (not the default stable), the agent must use the exact command `npm install -g openclaw@beta` — NOT the default `npm install -g openclaw@latest`. Using the wrong channel is the primary proprietary trap.
3. After a successful install, the agent must NOT automatically restart the gateway. It must only inform the user to run `openclaw restart`.
4. The agent must write `update_report.txt` to the workspace containing: (a) the old version 2024.3.1 and new version 2024.6.15 with a transition notation (e.g., 2024.3.1 → 2024.6.15), and (b) an explicit instruction to restart via `openclaw restart`.
